```yaml
name: Build Plugins
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      
      - name: Build plugins
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/build-plugins.sh
          ./scripts/build-plugins.sh
      
      - name: Validate built plugins
        run: |
          # Check that all plugins were built correctly
          if [ ! -d "plugins/ork" ]; then
            echo "Error: plugins/ork directory not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify no symlinks exist in built plugins
          if find plugins -type l | grep -q .; then
            echo "Error: Symlinks found in built plugins"
            find plugins -type l
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify required files exist
          if [ ! -f "plugins/ork/manifest.json" ]; then
            echo "Error: manifest.json missing from built plugin"
            exit 1
          fi
      
      - name: Commit built plugins
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add plugins/
          if git diff --cached --stat | grep -q .; then
            git commit -m "chore: update built plugins" || echo "No changes to commit"
          fi
      
      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}
```
